messages:
maria: Heads-up — ACME onboarding flagged missing IAM audit events in Splunk when using webhook delivery + KMS envelope. Missing actions: iam.role.update, api.key.rotate. Anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:

tony: Yep. Often an envelope vs schema mismatch. Splunk HEC mappings expect `event` top-level. If we wrap payload in an envelope or move tenant_id under metadata it gets lost in their props.conf/transforms.conf.

audit-bot: Audit Delivery: webhook POST to https://acme.example.com/hooks/ingest returned 200 but body was "accepted" and payload looked like base64 envelope. Retry count: 2.

oliver: Can you paste the raw headers/payload sample?

maria: Pasting sanitized sample (base64 and headers shortened):
```
POST /hooks/ingest HTTP/1.1
Host: acme.example.com
Content-Type: application/octet-stream
X-Redwood-Signature: sha256=...
X-Redwood-Schema: v3
X-Redwood-KMS-Key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd

<body>  // base64 envelope containing kms_encrypted_blob
```

maria: After decrypting envelope we get JSON where `tenant_id` is under `metadata.customer.tenant_id` instead of top-level `tenant_id` like ACME expects. Their Splunk transforms drop everything but top-level fields.

anika: ACME can't change their Splunk pipeline quickly. They asked for a compatibility shim on delivery so tenant_id shows up top-level.

sam: Quick options: 1) delivery-proxy rewrite for known destinations (Splunk/HEC) to lift tenant_id to top-level, 2) per-tenant compatibility toggle during onboarding, 3) ask customer to add props/transforms.conf (slow). I'd prefer (1)+(2) short-term.

tony: Agree but flagging security/consent: moving tenant_id top-level may reveal structure they didn't expect. Need explicit consent in onboarding contract. Also update RBAC: only `audit.delivery` service account can perform rewrite.

maria: Good point. For KMS specifics: ACME uses a cross-account KMS key to envelope events. We decrypt on our side using `kms:Decrypt`. Ensure the service role has `kms:Decrypt` for their key alias. If we're doing proxy rewrite we must verify signature after decryption before modifying payload.

oliver: SRE notes: delivery-proxy change plan — detect header `X-Redwood-Destination: splunk` OR customer flag `legacy_splunk_compat=true` -> perform shim: tenant_id = metadata.customer.tenant_id if present, add `redwood_transform=lift_tenant_v0` attribute and emit an internal audit event `audit.delivery.transform` recording transformation and who toggled it. This preserves traceability.

sam: Also add unit tests & a replay harness. Example command: `tools/audit-replay --target webhook --dest splunk --samples samples/iam_events.json --verify-signature`

maria: For incident/vuln triage: missing IAM events is high severity because it breaks forensic completeness. If ACME's ingestion dropped events for >24h we treat as incident and run postmortem. Until shim is live enable canary for ACME: 5% of events routed through shim and validated.

anika: I'll coordinate with CS to get explicit opt-in from ACME and capture it in onboarding ticket. Also sharing proposed Splunk props snippet they can use long-term.

sam: Schema question — should we bump schema to `v3.1` to document aliasing rules? Or keep `v3` and document compatibility adapters?

tony: Prefer adapter + feature flag. Schema bumps are breaking for many customers. But we should add a `schema.compatibility` section in docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-delivery (doc link placeholder).

oliver: Also need to verify S3 export and Datadog/ELK mappings — make sure shim doesn't alter S3 object structure for archival compliance. Shim should only affect webhook delivery output, not exported raw events.

maria: Test plan before rollout:
1) Generate synthetic IAM events (role.update, api.key.rotate)
2) Send to staging webhook with KMS envelope similar to ACME
3) Verify shim lifts tenant_id and Splunk HEC shows expected fields
4) Verify signatures/digests still validate (post-modification we should re-sign an `X-Redwood-Transform-Signature`)
5) Run regression against S3 export and Datadog outputs

sam: Security ask: we need a brief design doc for RBAC change — new `audit.delivery.rewrite` permission scoped per-tenant and a checkbox on onboarding form. I'll draft PR.

tony: I'll schedule the rollout window and the canary toggle in the console. Will add docs steps to the onboarding checklist: KMS key policy, required grants, Splunk HEC sample tokens, expected schema fields.

anika: I'll open the ACME onboarding ticket and include the temporary shim plan and timeline. Will also send them quick instructions for props/transforms.conf as a fallback.

maria: Thanks all. Action items: sam PR for RBAC + tests, tony rollout + feature flag, oliver proxy patch + audit event for transforms, anika customer consent + ticket. I'll coordinate postmortem template if incident later. :+1: :lock:
